figures.caption: Table 1: Average distance correlation, with standard deviations in parentheses, over 50 replications in nonlinear Euclidean SDR.
Table 2: Average distance correlation and projection error, with standard deviations in parentheses, over 50 replications in linear Euclidean SDR.
